title: Sundarpur's national accounts
body: The national accounts of an imaginary economy, Sundarpur, for one year show the following (Rs crore): Net National Product at market prices 9,000; net factor income from abroad (-) 200; depreciation 800; indirect taxes less subsidies 700; other current transfers received from the rest of the world, such as gifts and aid, 300. The planning board wants to know the maximum amount of goods and services the economy has at its disposal during the year, which is the idea behind National Disposable Income.
